name: Sigma - Security Event Log Cleared (T1070.001)
description: Windows Security (1102) ve ya System (104) loglarin silinmesini askar edir. MITRE T1070.001.

filter_expressions.expression: SELECT * FROM events WHERE LOGSOURCETYPENAME(devicetype) ILIKE '%Windows%' AND eventid IN (1102, 104) AND NOT (LOWER(username) = 'system' AND eventid = 104)

notes: EID 1102 (Security) ve EID 104 (System) log temizlenmesini izleyir. Yuksek riskli insidentdir.
